function.description: Read the CURRENT route for a service and join its current configuration. Returns record plus selection_token. The route is a separate resource; a configuration row version does not protect it.
function.name: resolve_service

function.description: Read one configuration by exact id. This does NOT resolve a service route.
function.name: get_config

function.name: update_config

function.description: Read the CURRENT READY batch for a lane with units >= min_units, highest priority then ascending id. Returns the chosen record plus selection_token. Selection depends on other rows; the chosen row version alone cannot protect ranking.
function.name: select_batch
